h: Truth and Love Complete the Peace of Shabbos

p: In the Minchah prayer on Shabbos
"And who is like Your people Yisrael,
there is the spreading of the shelter of peace,
and at the time of the third meal
the spreading of the shelter of peace is completed
For it says in the holy Zohar
(III, in the Addenda, end of siman 8)
corresponds to the attribute of Yesod,
It is also the attribute of peace,
as is known from several places:
in the Zohar at the end of Parshas Mikeitz
וּבְהַשְׁמָטוֹת זֹהַר חֵלֶק א סִימָן ג
and in the Hashmatos to Zohar I, siman 3
and this is the attribute of Yosef,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said in the Midrash
when they fell into his hand he recognized them
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
which is the attribute of truth,
as it says, "Grant truth to Yaakov";
and it says in the holy Zohar,
in the Hashmatos to part I, siman 37
and this is what is written (Yeshayahu 58:14):
"And I will feed you the heritage of Yaakov your father";
And in the Zohar, Vayikra (III 12b, top),
And this too is what is written
in the Zohar, Vayeishev (I 180a, at the end),
at the end of the passage opening "Eileh":
For Yaakov and Yosef are one level,
for from truth peace is drawn,
"and they do not move from there
until they become friends of one another";
is only for the sake of seeking truth,
peace afterward comes about between them.
when there is the flow of truth and peace,
and the spreading of the shelter of peace is completed
we say in the Minchah prayer:
"And who is like Your people Yisrael,
for the change in the text of the Shabbos prayers
follows the change in the holiness of the meals,
as I have already written several times.
that of the third meal it is written:
"And I will feed you the heritage of Yaakov your father, etc.;
For from the completeness of the holiness of this meal
נִמְשָׁךְ גַּם בְּכׇל שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
it is drawn into all six days of work;
and this is through the heritage of Yaakov,
And therefore they say in this prayer:
"Yaakov and his sons rest on it, etc.;
for this is the essence of completeness;
were accusers at the creation of man,
for he is all falsehoods and quarrels.
for the daughter is crowned with the Avos,
the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him
And it says in the Yerushalmi, Demai (chapter 4),
regarding asking him and eating on his word:
the awe of Shabbos is upon him,
and he cannot tell a lie.
it is the spreading of the shelter of peace
over us and over all Yisrael.
"You shall not kindle fire in any, etc."
and the early commentators explained it
(and its saying that it is the fire of Gehinnom
is as they said in Nedarim (22a):
all kinds of Gehinnom rule over him);
if he had a quarrel, etc.,
about those whom the Satan incited,
who would quarrel every Shabbos eve,
that Rabbi Meir drove him out of his house";
when it would have been more fitting
but the Satan is the one
and he is the evil angel
"May it be His will that it be
which is equal to the entire Torah,
as they said in the Midrash
as they said in the Mechilta
and keeps his hand from doing any evil."
was to accuse regarding another Shabbos too,
that it never ascend in completeness;
that it be so on another Shabbos,
that a mitzvah brings another mitzvah,
"Woe, that he drove him out, etc.";
for he had already become master of the house,
"in the end, master of the house";
And as they said in Shabbos (118b)
from the kingdoms and from the evil inclination
and from the Angel of Death;
although the world is judged by its majority
for through this he is guarded from sins,
and in the Pri Etz Chaim:
that he is saved from the accusation of the inclination.
יֵשׁ לוֹמַר נֶגֶד שְׁתֵּי מִדּוֹת הַנַּ״ל
one may say, correspond to the two attributes above;
for they are the root of evil
שֶׁבָּא מֵאֲכִילַת עֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע
that came from eating of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil;
for Yaakov absorbed all the good,
and Esav absorbed all the evil;
for this is the division of the worlds
of which our Sages, of blessed memory, said
that this one took the World to Come
which is the world of falsehood.
וְעַל כֵּן אָמְרוּ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (תּוֹלְדוֹת, סג, ח)
And therefore they said in Bereishis Rabbah (Toldos, 63:8)
as they said there in Bereishis Rabbah
that he hates a person's blood in his body;
and so they said in Bereishis Rabbah
that they are the haters of the world,
For there is evil toward Heaven
and therefore it is called falsehood
explicitly in the language of the verse;
and likewise every desire of this world
for it lasts only "for a moment,"
And the three roots of the husks of evil
(corresponding to the three Avos of holiness)
and the last is toward people,
(and Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
as is written in the Zohar several times,
and so they expounded in the Midrash
"Yaakov is the cord of His heritage":
And as I already wrote in explaining
that He cast Truth to the ground,
and it does not say so of Peace,
And the four expressions of rest:
first, "a rest of love and generosity"
it is from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
that from You is their rest";
and it is through love for Yisrael
and by the generosity of His heart,
without this gift being due to them,
"With love and with favor You gave us as heritage";
not like the rest of the wicked,
through the tranquility of this world,
whose end is grief and sighing,
and the Holy One, blessed be He,
is "a day of rest and holiness,"
and one says: "Who gives rest as a heritage
to His people Yisrael in His holiness."

p: Now our Sages, of blessed memory, said
(in Toras Kohanim, and cited in Rashi):
"'And you shall love your fellow as yourself'
this is a great principle in the Torah."
And what connection does this have
to the principle of the whole Torah?
Surely it is only a mitzvah
regarding the gentile who came to convert
on condition that they teach him the entire Torah
do not do to your fellow";
and Rashi, of blessed memory, explained:
"your fellow" — this is the Holy One, blessed be He.
וְאׇמְנָם כָּאן אֵין שַׁיָּיךְ לוֹמַר כֵּן
However, here one cannot say so,
for for the love of Hashem
"And you shall love Hashem your God."
Now in Tanna DeVei Eliyahu Rabbah
'And you shall love your fellow, etc.'
with regard to the Holy One, blessed be He,
'For the sake of my brothers and friends, etc.'";
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, explained:
and not bear sin because of him'
when he does to you what is not to your liking,
'And do not bear because of him'
to cover the hatred in your heart";
And so Hashem Yisbarach conducts Himself
as a father the son he favors."
and the revelation of the love
as is known from the Baal Shem Tov;
and it is also in the Midrash
that as a person conducts himself,
כֵּן הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מִתְנַהֵג עִמּוֹ
so the Holy One, blessed be He, conducts Himself with him,
because a person conducts himself with compassion
so too the Holy One, blessed be He,
that this is the intent of the verse's wording:
"And you shall love your fellow as yourself;
And what is the relevance of the conclusion
with your brother and your fellow with love,
and do not bear sin because of him,
will conduct Myself with you likewise.
And it is from this aspect
that "And you shall love your fellow as yourself"
is a great principle in the Torah:
that is, for the upholding of the Torah;
and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him,
And how will he merit this,
that "Hashem will not abandon him into its hand"?
This is through "And you shall love, etc.":
with people in the good way,
sets the eye of His providence upon him
in the good and straight way.
Until here from his holy manuscript.
